name: Scriv
text: Kaedim’s lack of a usable description isn’t permanent—it’s a gap we can close in hours by demanding the missing data from the source. Ignoring it now risks missing a higher-value target later; the Alima video alone won’t unlock the full access gate. Settle this by forcing a 24-hour deadline for Kaedim’s description—if it arrives, split focus; if not, Alima is the only play.
